tochegando.title: Tô Chegando Bar & Restaurant
tochegando.problem: The venue took reservations only by phone and messages, with no organized record and lost requests at peak hours.
tochegando.solution: A complete website with online bookings, a login area and an admin panel where the staff manages requests — authentication and database on Supabase. It also brings a digital menu, gallery, FAQ and direct WhatsApp contact, plus an Instagram integration that keeps the page alive with no manual work.
tochegando.imageAlt: Home page of the Tô Chegando Bar & Restaurant website
